description: This file defines the EmailUI class which provides methods for rendering the email interface, managing folders and mailbox nodes, handling address book operations, and generating email compose data within the SuiteCRM system. It includes functionality for displaying email frames, creating folders, managing cache, and integrating with IMAP mailboxes.

classes.name: EmailUI
classes.description: This class encapsulates the functionality for managing the email user interface within SuiteCRM, including rendering email frames, handling folder and mailbox operations, address book management, and email composition.

methods.name: displayEmailFrame
methods.description: Renders the main email interface with folder tree and mailbox view.

methods.name: displayQuickComposeEmailFrame
methods.description: Generates the HTML and JS for a quick compose email form loaded via AJAX.

methods.name: _loadQuickCreateModules
methods.description: Loads available modules for quick email creation based on metadata and permissions.

methods.name: generateComposePackageForQuickCreateFromComposeUrl
methods.description: Parses a compose URL and generates a data package for quick email composition.

methods.name: createEmailLink
methods.description: Creates an HTML mailto link for a given email address and related entity info.

methods.name: populateComposeViewFields
methods.description: Prepares email compose fields for a given bean, including handling opt-in and invalid email states.

methods.name: createBulkActionEmailLink
methods.description: Returns an HTML link for bulk email actions.

methods.name: getEmailAddressConfirmOptInTick
methods.description: Retrieves HTML for the opt-in checkbox tick for email addresses.

methods.name: generateComposePackageForQuickCreate
methods.description: Creates a data package for quick email creation, possibly lazy-loaded.

methods.name: _generateComposeConfigData
methods.description: Generates configuration data needed for email compose UIs including language packs and TinyMCE settings.

methods.name: getContacts
methods.description: Retrieves the user's address book contacts.

methods.name: setContacts
methods.description: Saves new contacts to the user's address book.

methods.name: removeContacts
methods.description: Removes specified contacts from the address book.

methods.name: saveContactEdit
methods.description: Saves edited contact information, including email addresses.

methods.name: getEditContact
methods.description: Prepares data for editing contact details, returning a form.

methods.name: getUserContacts
methods.description: Retrieves concatenated contact list with details and email addresses.

methods.name: getUserPreferencesJS
methods.description: Returns user preferences related to the email UI, including folder states and display options.

methods.name: getUserPrefsJS
methods.description: Alias for getUserPreferencesJS.

methods.name: saveNewFolder
methods.description: Creates and saves a new email folder.

methods.name: saveListViewSortOrder
methods.description: Saves the sorting preferences for email list views.

methods.name: saveFolderOpenState
methods.description: Saves the open/closed state of a folder in user preferences.

methods.name: saveListView
methods.description: Saves the current folder view state for a particular folder.

methods.name: preflightEmailCache
methods.description: Prepares directory structure for caching email data.

methods.name: deleteEmailCacheForFolders
methods.description: Deletes cached folder structure files.

methods.name: emptyTrash
methods.description: Empties the trash folder for all subscribed mailboxes.

methods.name: getMailboxNodes
methods.description: Builds the mailbox tree nodes for the folder tree UI, including IMAP mailboxes.

methods.name: getMailBoxesFromCacheValue
methods.description: Retrieves mailbox list from cache or remote source.

methods.name: buildTreeNode
methods.description: Creates a tree node with mailbox folder details and unread counters.

methods.name: getUnreadCount
methods.description: Returns the unread email count for a mailbox.

methods.name: getDraftAttachments
methods.description: Fetches attachments for draft emails.

methods.name: createCopyOfInboundAttachment
methods.description: Creates a local copy of an inbound email attachment.

methods.name: parseAttachmentInfo
methods.description: Parses HTML data to extract attachment info.

methods.name: getQuickCreateForm
methods.description: Generates the HTML form for quick email creation.

methods.name: setReadFlag
methods.description: Sets the "read" flag in the overview cache for an email.

methods.name: markEmails
methods.description: Marks emails with specified flags (read, unread, flagged, deleted) in local cache and email server.

methods.name: doAssignment
methods.description: Assigns emails to users based on distribution method, including importing emails from inbound servers.

methods.name: doDistributionWithMethod
methods.description: Distributes emails to users based on specified method: round robin, least busy, or direct.

methods.name: distRoundRobin
methods.description: Distributes emails to users in a round robin fashion.

methods.name: distLeastBusy
methods.description: Distributes emails to the user with the least number of unread emails.

methods.name: distDirect
methods.description: Assigns all emails directly to a single user.

methods.name: getAssignedEmailsCountForUsers
methods.description: Returns the count of unread emails assigned to each user.

methods.name: getLastRobin
methods.description: Retrieves the last user ID assigned in round robin distribution for a mailbox.

methods.name: setLastRobin
methods.description: Sets the last user ID used in round robin distribution, updating cache files.

methods.name: getSingleMessage
methods.description: Returns the metadata defining a single email message for display, utilizing cache files.

methods.name: getListEmails
methods.description: Returns an HTML list of emails within a folder, using cache or server retrieval.

methods.name: displayComposeEmail
methods.description: Returns a template for composing or replying to an email, including prefilled fields and headers.

methods.name: handleReplyType
methods.description: Formats email body on reply or forward, adjusting headers accordingly.

methods.name: _getPeopleUnionQuery
methods.description: Generates a UNION SQL query to get a combined list of people (users, contacts, leads, prospects, accounts) for address book.

methods.name: getRelatedEmail
methods.description: Retrieves emails related to a bean, including from relationships.

methods.name: findEmailFromBeanIds
methods.description: Builds an SQL query to find emails associated with given bean IDs.

methods.name: _cleanUIDList
methods.description: Cleans UID lists, sorting and optionally returning as a string.

methods.name: createFolder
methods.description: Creates a new email folder object.

methods.name: preflightUser
methods.description: Initializes default folders for a user if they do not exist.

methods.name: generateDynamicFolderQuery
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions for dynamic folders such as inbound, drafts, sent, archived.

methods.name: preflightUserCache
methods.description: Prepares user's email cache directory, deleting existing files.

methods.name: clearInboundAccountCache
methods.description: Deletes cached data for inbound email account.

methods.name: getEmailTemplatesArray
methods.description: Returns the list of email templates accessible to the user.

methods.name: getFromAccountsArray
methods.description: Returns array of inbound account options for composing email, including system accounts.

methods.name: getFromAllAccountsArray
methods.description: Returns array of all inbound accounts that match email address, considering system, personal, and group accounts.

methods.name: arrayToXML
methods.description: Converts an array to XML string.

methods.name: getShowAccountsOptions
methods.description: Builds options for selecting inbound email accounts, including group folders.

methods.name: getShowAccountsOptionsForSearch
methods.description: Builds search options for inbound email accounts.

methods.name: displaySuccessMessage
methods.description: Displays a success message after operations like delete.

methods.name: validCacheFileExists
methods.description: Checks existence and validity of cache files based on timeout.

methods.name: getCacheValue
methods.description: Retrieves data stored in cache files.

methods.name: getCacheTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of a cache file.

methods.name: setCacheTimestamp
methods.description: Updates cache file timestamp, usually after email check.
